notes: NA ranges are total comp (base + bonus + equity). EMEA ranges are typically base + small bonus, less equity. APAC and LATAM ranges are in USD equivalent for normalization; actual local currency may vary by market. NA leadership roles include significant equity (RSU/options) as noted.

eng-backend.name: Backend Engineer
eng-backend.notes: Core software engineering role. NA total comp includes base + bonus + equity (RSUs at mid+).

eng-sre.name: Site Reliability Engineer
eng-sre.notes: On-call rotation typical. May include 10-15% on-call premium.

eng-frontend.name: Frontend Engineer
eng-frontend.notes: Slightly lower ceiling than backend at senior+ at some firms.

eng-mobile.name: Mobile Engineer
eng-mobile.notes: Comparable to backend. iOS/Android specialization premium at senior level.

eng-data.name: Data Engineer
eng-data.notes: Growing demand driving comp closer to backend ranges.

eng-qa.name: QA / Test Engineer
eng-qa.notes: Manual QA at low end, SDET (automation-focused) at high end.

eng-devops.name: DevOps Engineer
eng-devops.notes: High demand. Infrastructure automation and CI/CD expertise.

eng-platform.name: Platform Engineer
eng-platform.notes: Internal developer platform focus. Comparable to DevOps.

eng-arch.name: Software Architect
eng-arch.notes: Technical leadership. Requires system design expertise. Equity-heavy at top end.

eng-ml.name: ML/AI Engineer
eng-ml.notes: Premium over backend. PhD or MS often required for senior+. Includes 500K-2000K equity.

eng-infrastructure.name: Infrastructure Engineer
eng-infrastructure.notes: Cloud infrastructure, networking, and systems. On-call common.

tech-net-admin.name: Network Administrator
tech-net-admin.notes: Network hardware, routing, switching. Certifications (CCNA/CCNP) boost comp.

tech-sys-admin.name: Systems Administrator
tech-sys-admin.notes: Server management, OS administration. DevOps/SRE skills increase ceiling.

tech-dba.name: Database Administrator
tech-dba.notes: SQL, NoSQL, performance tuning. Cloud DB (RDS, Aurora, BigQuery) skills add premium.

tech-cloud-architect.name: Cloud Architect
tech-cloud-architect.notes: Multi-cloud design, migration strategy, cost optimization. Certifications valued.

tech-ai-engineer.name: AI Engineer
tech-ai-engineer.notes: LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, model deployment. Cutting-edge premium.

tech-robotics-engineer.name: Robotics Engineer
tech-robotics-engineer.notes: ROS, embedded systems, computer vision. Hardware+software hybrid. Niche premium.

exec-ceo.name: Chief Executive Officer
exec-ceo.notes: Highly variable by company stage. Seed: 1500K-2500K, Series A: 2500K-5000K, Public: 1M-50M+. Significant equity component (often 50-80% of total).

exec-cto.name: Chief Technology Officer
exec-cto.notes: Equity-heavy for early-stage. Public company CTO: 60-80% equity. VP/Director-level for larger firms.

exec-cfo.name: Chief Financial Officer
exec-cfo.notes: Public company CFO: significant equity. Private: base-heavy with performance bonus.

exec-coo.name: Chief Operating Officer
exec-coo.notes: Often second-in-command. Variable by industry (tech, manufacturing, services).

exec-cmo.name: Chief Marketing Officer
exec-cmo.notes: Brand marketing, demand gen, growth responsibilities. Tech CMO premium over traditional.

exec-chief-staff.name: Chief of Staff
exec-chief-staff.notes: Strategic operations role. Often path to VP/C-suite. Common in tech and consulting.

prd-manager.name: Product Manager
prd-manager.notes: Technical PMs at top end. FAANG PM: premium over product-focused PM.

prd-owner.name: Product Owner
prd-owner.notes: Scrum-focused. Typically lower than Product Manager. Common in agencies/enterprise.

prd-strategy.name: Product Strategist
prd-strategy.notes: Senior IC role. Roadmap, market analysis, competitive intelligence. Sometimes called Principal Product Manager.

dsg-ux.name: UX Researcher / Designer
dsg-ux.notes: UX research premium over pure visual design. Portfolio-driven.

dsg-ui.name: UI / Visual Designer
dsg-ui.notes: Visual design, design systems. Coding ability (HTML/CSS) increases ceiling.

dsg-brand.name: Brand Designer
dsg-brand.notes: Brand identity, logo design, guidelines. Agency vs in-house varies widely.

mkt-content.name: Content Marketer
mkt-content.notes: Writing, SEO content, thought leadership. Senior roles require strategy + team management.

mkt-seo.name: SEO Specialist
mkt-seo.notes: Technical SEO and content SEO. Analytics skills command premium. Performance bonuses common.

mkt-growth.name: Growth Marketer
mkt-growth.notes: Data-driven growth, experimentation, paid acquisition. Performance bonus heavy.

mkt-analytics.name: Marketing Analytics Manager
mkt-analytics.notes: Marketing mix modeling, attribution, dashboards. SQL/Python skills valued.

sls-ae.name: Account Executive
sls-ae.notes: Base + commission (variable often 50-100% of base). OTE (on-target earnings) listed. Enterprise AE at high end.

sls-bdr.name: BDR / SDR
sls-bdr.notes: Base + commission. Entry-level sales role. Promotion path to AE in 12-24 months.

sls-customer-success.name: Customer Success Manager
sls-customer-success.notes: Retention, expansion revenue, QBRs. Outcome-based bonus structure.

hr-recruiting.name: Recruiter
hr-recruiting.notes: Agency vs in-house. Tech recruiter premium. Contingency vs retained search varies.

hr-talent.name: Talent Management / HRBP
hr-talent.notes: HR Business Partner or Talent Development. Strategic roles command premium.

fin-fpa.name: FP&A Analyst
fin-fpa.notes: Financial planning, budgeting, forecasting. CFO track. SaaS metrics expertise valued.

fin-accounting.name: Accountant
fin-accounting.notes: Public accounting vs corporate. CPA certification adds 10-15%. Audit/prepare financial statements.

fin-audit.name: Auditor
fin-audit.notes: Internal or external audit. Big 4 premium then exit to industry. CPA required for senior.

lgl-contracts.name: Contracts Attorney
lgl-contracts.notes: Negotiation, drafting, compliance. In-house counsel at tech firms on higher end.

lgl-privacy.name: Privacy Attorney
lgl-privacy.notes: GDPR, CCPA, data protection. High demand. Tech and healthcare premium.

lgl-employment.name: Employment Attorney
lgl-employment.notes: Employment law, compliance, disputes. In-house at large companies vs law firm.

hlth-physician.name: Physician (MD)
hlth-physician.notes: Highly specialty-dependent. Primary care at low end, specialists (derm, radiology, cardiology) at high end.

hlth-nurse.name: Registered Nurse
hlth-nurse.notes: RN: base hourly. NP/APRN (Nurse Practitioner) at higher end. Shift differentials add 10-20%.

hlth-surgeon.name: Surgeon
hlth-surgeon.notes: Years of training (5-10 years residency/fellowship). Specialty: ortho, neuro, cardiac at top end.

hlth-dentist.name: Dentist
hlth-dentist.notes: Private practice vs corporate. Specialists (ortho, oral surgery) at high end. DDS/DMD required.

hlth-pharmacist.name: Pharmacist
hlth-pharmacist.notes: Retail vs clinical. PharmD required. Hospital and industry roles at higher end.

hlth-veterinarian.name: Veterinarian
hlth-veterinarian.notes: DVM required. Small animal vs large animal vs specialty (surgery, neurology) varies. Lower pay than human med.

cre-art-director.name: Art Director
cre-art-director.notes: Creative lead on projects. Agency background common. Team management at senior level.

cre-graphic-designer.name: Graphic Designer
cre-graphic-designer.notes: Print, digital, branding. Portfolio-driven. UX crossover increases ceiling.

cre-content-creator.name: Content Creator / Influencer
cre-content-creator.notes: Highly variable. Platform (YouTube, TikTok, IG), audience size, sponsorship revenue. Not salary but annualized earnings.

cre-film-director.name: Film / Video Director
cre-film-director.notes: Commercial, film, TV. Project-based often. Day rates common. Top-tier can earn >1M annually.

cre-game-designer.name: Game Designer
cre-game-designer.notes: Game mechanics, level design, systems design. Mobile gaming vs AAA console. Unity/Unreal skills.

trade-carpenter.name: Carpenter
trade-carpenter.notes: Union vs non-union. Commercial vs residential. Master carpenter premium.

trade-electrician.name: Electrician
trade-electrician.notes: Licensed journeyman. Union scale varies by region. Master electrician at top end.

trade-plumber.name: Plumber
trade-plumber.notes: Licensed journeyman. Union scale varies. Emergency services can add significant overtime.

trade-machinist.name: Machinist / CNC Operator
trade-machinist.notes: Manual and CNC machining. Aerospace and precision manufacturing premium. Certification valued.

edu-teacher.name: Teacher (K-12)
edu-teacher.notes: Public school salary schedules by district + years of experience. Master degree add-on. Private school varies.

edu-professor.name: Professor (University)
edu-professor.notes: Tenure track vs adjunct (adjunct much lower). By rank: Assistant, Associate, Full. Research grants supplement.

govt-police-officer.name: Police Officer
govt-police-officer.notes: Union scale, locality adjustments. Overtime common. Rank: officer, sergeant, lieutenant, captain.

govt-firefighter.name: Firefighter
govt-firefighter.notes: Civil service scale. 24/48 or 48/96 schedules. Paramedic certification adds premium.

hosp-chef.name: Chef
hosp-chef.notes: CDC (executive chef) at top end. Fine dining vs casual. Michelin prestige can command premium.

hosp-hotel-manager.name: Hotel Manager
hosp-hotel-manager.notes: Hospitality management. Property size and tier (luxury, select-service) drive comp. GM role at top end.

beauty-hairstylist.name: Hairstylist
beauty-hairstylist.notes: Commission-based (40-60% of service revenue). Tips add 15-25%. Salon owner/rental chair model higher.

sport-coach.name: Coach (Professional)
sport-coach.notes: Widely variable. High school/college: 300K-1500K. Professional: 5000K-10M+. NCAA Division I on high end.
